ProfessionalService

class ProfessionalService(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: QObject

Business rules (service layer) of professionals.

A single instance is shared by the whole application.

Parameters:
daoProfessionalCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO used for persistence. Default is None, which creates a new ProfessionalCsvDAO.

Attributes:
professional_changeSignal(int)

Emitted after a change: with the ID of the created or updated professional, or with 0 after a deletion.

daoProfessionalCsvDAO

DAO used for persistence.

institution_serviceInstitutionFacilityService

Facility service; its DAO is shared with the professional DAO.

Methods

get_all_professionals()

Return all registered professionals.

Return the validation errors of the form data.

Create a professional from a data dictionary.

Update an existing professional.

Delete a professional by its ID.

Return a professional by its ID.

Search professionals by name or ID (case-insensitive).

get_professional_types()

Return the translated professional types.

get_all_institutionfacilities()

Return all facilities sorted by name.

get_institutionfacility_by_id(institution_id)

Return a facility by its ID.

Notes

__new__ always returns the same instance, and __init__ sets it up only once: a dao passed in later calls is ignored.

When no dao is given, the professional DAO is created with the DAO of InstitutionFacilityService, so facilities are resolved from the same cache.

validate_data(data)[source]

Validate the form data of a professional.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Form data.

Returns:
list[str]

Translated error messages, each ending with a newline; empty when the data is valid.

Notes

The id is required and must be an int; name must not be blank; type must not be 0; institutionfacility is required.

The messages (pt_BR source texts) are translated at runtime with self.tr().

create_professional(data)[source]

Create a professional from a dictionary.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Values for every Professional field. An id of 0 or less gets the next free ID.

Returns:
Professional | None

The created professional, or None if it is not valid or its ID already exists.

Raises:
TypeError

If data misses a field or has an unknown key.

Notes

professional_change is emitted with the new ID on success.

update_professional(professional_id, data)[source]

Update an existing professional with new values.

Parameters:
professional_idint

ID of the professional to update.

datadict[str, Any]

Updated fields; missing keys keep the current value.

Returns:
bool

True if the professional was found, is valid and was saved; False otherwise.

Notes

The cached object is changed in place before validation, so an invalid update still changes it in memory. professional_change is emitted with the ID on success.
